### Data Centres & Power
**Plans progress for 200MW data center in Schladen-Werla, Germany: Data Center Dynamics**
Green Datacenter Development is advancing plans for a 200 MW data center in Schladen-Werla, Germany. The project remains in the planning phase with no construction start date announced. The 200 MW capacity figure represents the target IT load for the facility. Local permitting and grid studies are understood to be underway. No tenant or power source details were released.
Source: ht

### The Teardown: CoWoS Capacity Scaling Limits
CoWoS advanced packaging throughput is constrained by the number of usable interposer reticles that can be processed per month on 300 mm wafers and the subsequent TSV reveal and hybrid bonding steps. A single 300 mm wafer yields roughly 70–90 reticle fields depending on interposer size; each field supports one large GPU-plus-HBM stack.
